name: Embla Medical hf.
summary: Embla Medical hf is an international enterprise focused on orthopedics, dedicated to the innovation, enhancement, production, and worldwide distribution of non-surgical orthopedic solutions. Its business activities are organized across various geographical divisions, including the Americas, the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region, and a unified segment encompassing both the Americas and Asia-Pacific. The company was established in 1971 by Össur Kristinsson and has its primary corporate office situated in Reykjavík, Iceland.
